linter_flag_corrigendum.root_cause: The project's substrate taxonomy had 5 legal inference_substrate values at the time this task ran, none of which fit 'live embedding-only forward passes against a local model'. live_llm_inference's 60s floor assumes full generative decoding; verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates's 1s floor assumes the LLM is NOT loaded at all. This task genuinely did load the LLM (gemma-4-26B-A4B-it GGUF) but only for single-pass embedding extraction (48 candidates), not generation -- duration_s=35.28s is implausible under the 60s floor but is plausible model-load-plus-48-embeddings compute, and no existing category could say so honestly.
linter_flag_corrigendum.fix: scripts/adversarial_verify.py: added live_llm_embedding_extraction as the 6th legal substrate value (LLM_EMBEDDING_EXTRACTION_SUBSTRATE, 2.0s floor -- calibrated as the minimum plausible time to load any real local GGUF and complete at least one embedding forward pass), wired into duration_floor_for_artifact() ahead of the generic live_llm_inference check. Documented in CLAUDE.md's Inference-Substrate Declaration Discipline table. Reclassified this artifact's own inference_substrate to the new value (was 'live_llm_inference', the wrong category for what actually ran).
linter_flag_corrigendum.underlying_finding_preserved: This correction does not change the artifact's substance: hidden_state_verifier_accuracy=0.0 (0/6, worse than tuned_sc_baseline_accuracy=0.333, an honest but severely underpowered null at n=6 questions, mcnemar_p_value=0.5). The one genuinely interesting signal -- identically_wrong_detection_result showing the hidden-state probe correctly flagged the one case where two candidates shared the same wrong answer, something plain majority vote structurally cannot detect -- is a single data point, not a headline claim.

model_specs.note: Added 2026-07-03 alongside the substrate correction -- the model was already named in hidden_state_access_metadata.gguf_path but not surfaced as a top-level model_specs field, which the methodology check requires for compute-bound artifacts.
